shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && echo "---TREE---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/blog/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js components/AppProvider.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json styles/globals.css __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=========== $f"; cat "$f"; done
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && echo "---" && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/*/ && echo "=== AGENTS" && cat node_modules/next/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -100

head -60 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md; echo "=====NOTFOUND FN"; head -60 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/not-found.md; echo "=====USEROUTER"; head -70 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-router.md

sed -n '/^## Time-based revalidation/,/^## On-demand/p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; echo "=== ISR GUIDE ==="; head -120 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/incremental-static-regeneration.md
head -90 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/font.md; echo "=== FONTS GETTING STARTED ==="; head -70 node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md
git rm -r --cached pages components/AppProvider.js -q && rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && ls -R app components lib
for f in .next/server/app/blog.html .next/server/app/blog/1.html; do echo "== $f"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|<meta name="description"[^>]*>\|<meta property="og:[^>]*>' "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
grep -o '<meta[^>]*>' .next/server/app/blog/1.html | head -20; echo "=== 404 metas"; grep -o '<meta[^>]*>' .next/server/app/_not-found.html | head
grep -c "description" .next/server/app/blog/1.html; grep -o 'description[^,}]\{0,80\}' .next/server/app/blog/1.html | head -5; echo "--- rsc"; ls .next/server/app/blog/ | head
curl -s localhost:3111/ | head -c 1500 | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>"; echo "---blog"; curl -s localhost:3111/blog | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -2
curl -s -i -X OPTIONS localhost:3111/api/posts | head -5; echo "=== stop"; pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; echo done
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"

(npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -o '<meta name="description"[^>]*>\|<meta property="og:title"[^>]*>' | head -3; pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f next-server; echo stopped
git status --short && git diff --stat -- package.json && cat tsconfig.json
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"; git status --short
